scope: Fixed non-held HST footprint mechanics control only; no target observation request, product download, ranking, release or holdout evaluation.

known_control.geometry_assumptions: Use the saved MAST ICRS s_region interpretation and minor great-circle edges; the polygon literal omits its own frame token. This does not validate detector pixels or absolute astrometric registration.

multiplicity_and_cap.coverage: unknown; potentially incomplete despite OK status
multiplicity_and_cap.order_note: ORDER BY objid is not a total order; access variants are not independent observations.

privacy.limitation: Treat all returned access values and native headers as untrusted; presence or absence of obvious credential markers does not establish public or private access.

limitations: Positive mechanics for this fixed known point only; no current negative control or validation of all footprint cases.
At-cap response does not establish complete archive coverage.
An ObsCore footprint row does not establish source attribution, detector coverage, image availability or resolution.
Raw-response and prior-response hashes differ; the actual row tuples match as a multiset, while their order differs.
No held-source findings or dispositions changed.
